claim: Theranos offers a comprehensive menu of lab tests in convenient locations in its Walgreens Wellness Centers in Arizona and California, with plans to expand throughout the country.

res.reason: The claim is presented in the present tense, but Walgreens terminated its partnership with Theranos in June 2016 and closed all 40 Theranos Wellness Centers in Arizona, per Walgreens' own press release and NPR and the New York Times reporting.

claim: Theranos lab tests are available in forty-two Theranos Wellness Centers in the Phoenix area, and Theranos is now expanding throughout the state.

res.reason: The claim's core element (Theranos Wellness Centers in the Phoenix area offering lab tests) is supported by Walgreens' press release and NPR, which report the company operated 40 such centers in Arizona, not forty-two.
